243:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Have we been transported again...?!」

243:t_000:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I've confirmed our present location...! We're near $$木星$$, in the world we came from!」

243:t_000:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Again... We've traveled from the galactic center to the solar system in an instant...」

243:t_000:5.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「A ship is approaching us!」

243:t_001:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$...!」

243:t_001:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They've returned to the solar system, too...」

243:t_001:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「With so many bizarre things happening, can we really just be happy about this...?」

243:t_001:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Let's join up with them and exchange information first.」

243:t_001:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(The galactic center... then a mysterious universe... Then a return to the solar system and a reunion with our allies... It's all too convenient...)

243:t_001:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Is this... the work of someone's will...?)

uncertain: 243:t_001:4-5: Captains suspect outside orchestration; phrased as suspicion, not a confirmed fact.
